title: Move items to the front
prompt:
Write `MoveToFront(items []string, target string)` that moves every `target` to the front of `items`, in place, in one pass and with no extra slice. The order of the other items doesn't matter.

`[knife fork spoon fork]`, `"fork"` → `[fork fork spoon knife]`
hint: Keep a write index `w`; when `items[i]` is the target, swap it into `w` and advance `w`.
